reasons: The cited § 6 MFN runs in the Customer's (Mortgage Logic.com's) favour — TrueLink warrants Hosting Services rates will not exceed those charged to any other party, plus a one-year price freeze — which is exactly the rule's preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer; Vendor-granted MFN welcome).
No obligation on Client to extend or match third-party terms appears in the cited text or definitions, supporting the 'compliant' classification rather than a deviation.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the rendered redline is byte-identical to the original paragraph and no counterparty comment is proposed; no deterministic checks failed.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately records the finding as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
